title: Quest Foglight for Databases EncryptionUtil Hardcoded Encyption Key Local Privilege Escalation… (CVE-2026-92199)
description: CVE-2026-92199 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases caused by a hard-coded cryptographic key in the symmetricDecrypt method. An attacker with low-privileged code execution can exploit this flaw to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level and execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability has a high CVSS score of 7.8, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
